Hello, everyone!

We hope the beginning of summer has been off to a great start for you all!

Our annual Steam Summer Sale is going on right now where you can get up to 90% off, but we also want to mention Steam Next Fest where we debuted demos for several of our upcoming titles!

We had not one, not 2, not even 3, but 4 demos to show off, and we thank each and every one of you who played them and spread the word.

For those unaware, here's a short summary of what each title is about:

Tamarak Trail is a deck-building roguelike where you'll use a customizable dice set as you battle through randomly generated trails full of loot, mysteries, and danger to protect inhabitants from the evil that has corrupted the trail.

In Lil' Guardsman, imagine you're a 12-year-old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

Broken Roads is a narrative-driven RPG that brings exploration, strategic turn-based combat and meaningful philosophical choices to an all-new Australian post-apocalyptic setting.

Finally, in Stray Souls, enter a world of nightmares in this third person, action-horror, inspired by the classics of the genre. Fight terrifying creatures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel a horrid family secret to expose the chilling truth behind your existence.

If any or all of them pique your interest, add them to your wishlist now! And don't forget to check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of existing titles for those glorious Summer Sale discounts!

notes.title: Versus Evil 8th Anniversary Sale Going on Now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil is turning 8! Can you believe it? Well, believe it because to celebrate we're having a sale on our awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of games!

Over these past 8 years, we've had the opportunity to help put out many fun and creative games. This year saw the release of Jumpala, Hitchhiker - A Mystery Game, and Sockventure, as well as Early Access releases for First Class Trouble, Almighty: Kill Your Gods, and The Hand of Merlin. Tomorrow sees the release of our latest addition, UnMetal!

UnMetal is a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base using his wits and fists.

Sounds like fun, right? Check out UnMetal and the rest of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] for anything that may interest you!

To close, some thanks are in order...

Thank you to our developers who really give it their all to bring these games to life.

Thank you to our Heralds who are the best ambassadors we could ever hope for.

And, of course, thank you to our players who are the reason we continue to strive to put out the best games we possibly can. This has been one long, crazy journey, and we're glad you're all on it with us.

From all of us at Versus Evil, thank you for making these past 8 years great. Now, go score some deals!

notes.title: WINTERMOOR TACTICS CLUB IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2E2nZmiMqyk;full][/previewyoutube]

Wintermoor Tactics Club is finally available and we're celebrating launch with a limited time 10% discount!

If you like the music, you can get the game with the soundtrack at a discount with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14291]Wintermost Bundle[/url].
We've also made a bundle that combines Wintermoor with digital board game Antihero in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14292]Heroes and Antiheroes Bundle[/url].

Wintermoor Tactics Club is a narrative-driven tactics RPG married with visual novel elements. You play as Alicia, one of the members of the Wintermoor Academy Tactics Club, where students play the premier tabletop game of the time, Curses & Catacombs. A mandatory snowball tournament between all of the clubs is announced by the Principal and each losing club is disbanded. Now you and your friends need to use your tactical skills to fight rival clubs, while also exploring the school and investigating the Principal’s true motivations for the tournament.

When we started making Wintermoor Tactics Club, we wanted to make a tactics game with a narrative that was just as engaging as the tactics.
At first, it seems like a typical 80s "underdog nerds vs. cool kids" narrative. But it quickly subverts that to reveal a deeper story. At the same time, we wanted Wintermoor Tactics Club to be a comfortable introduction to tactics games. We did this by streamlining the classic Tactics RPG experience: no randomness, low numbers, and no hidden information. All of this is wrapped up in a cozy, 'hygge' aesthetic that's light-hearted and has an earnest sense of humor.

Currently we're launching in English, but in a matter of weeks we'll be adding Russian, Chinese (simplified), German, and Brazilian Portuguese language support. If you're not a native English speaker, but are looking forward to play, please Wishlist us so you'll be alerted once we add your language.
We're so proud of what we've made and are truly grateful for all the community support.

Stay in touch with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/versusevil]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/vs_evil]Twitter[/url] for more news on Wintermoor Tactics Club!
